newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pamplona may invite Clinton to bull run.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pamplona may invite Clinton to bull run.

text.p: The Spanish city of Pamplona may invite U.S. President Bill Clinton to its famed running of the bulls festival in July when he is due to attend a NATO expansion summit in Madrid.
Municipal officials said on Wednesday they were considering inviting Clinton to the nine-day San Fermin festival starting on July 7, a day before the NATO summit.
The bullfighting spectacle was made famous by Ernest Hemingway in his 1926 novel "The Sun Also Rises," but, if Clinton does attend, he could anger animal rights activists both back home and in Spain.
During the festival, six massive fighting bulls are let loose every day to dash through narrow cobbled streets from their corral to the arena where they are later killed in bullfights.
